adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"` and an `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` that does not read params or persist anything (it just re-renders `@embedding`). On the client, `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` defines `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but `admin/templates/embedding.hbs` has no UI element/action invoking `saveChanges` (only `addHost` and per-host save/delete). This creates a misleading/unused “save” contract and a seemingly dead endpoint/action, but it doesn’t break existing behavior shown in the diff because host CRUD is handled via `EmbeddableHostsController`.
